fusions.name: Arcane Hum
fusions.desc: Releases a humming cone of raw arcana that deals 10 damage to everything in it, stuns them for 0.8 seconds and leaves them [Muddled] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Unwarded Venom
fusions.desc: A thrown sting that deals 30 damage, up to 1.3 times that at full reach, ignores resistances and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Spell Returned
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 40% of the elemental damage you take is sent back to whoever dealt it.

fusions.name: Mana From Welts
fusions.desc: When you afflict an enemy, you restore 4 mana. Once every 3 seconds.
